ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ ۚ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ ۚ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًٔا ۚ فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۚ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ ۖ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا الْأُخْرَى ۚ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ ۚ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ ۖ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا ۗ وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ ۚ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ ۚ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: أَفَمَن كَانَ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ وَيَتْلُوهُ شَاهِدٌ مِّنْهُ وَمِن قَبْلِهِۦ كِتَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِمَامًا وَرَحْمَةً ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ فَٱلنَّارُ مَوْعِدُهُۥ ۚ فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: إِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُوا۟ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥ وَٱللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَ

ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

ayahOccurrences.text: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا

ayahOccurrences.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ

ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا

lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ش/ﻫ/د sh–h–d landmark
; presence, to witness, to testify to what 1 has witnessed, seen or beheld with one’s own eyes; to be or become a martyr.

Of this root, 13 forms occur 158 times in the Qur’an:
شَهِد shahida 44 times;أشْهَدَ ʾashhada 7 times; اسْتَشْهِد ʾishtashhid 2 times;شاهِد shāhid 16 times;شُهود shuhūd 3 times; أشْهاد ʾashhād 2 times;شَهيد shahıd 35 times; شَهيديَن shahıdayn 1 time;شُهَداء shuhadāʾ 20 times;شَهادةٌ shahādatun 23 times;شَهادات shahādāt 2 times; مَشْهَد mashhad 1 time and مشُهود mashhūd 2 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
شُهَداء shuhadāʾ [pl. ofشَهيد shahıd]

1 witnesses

(24:4) وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً those who accuse chaste women [of adultery], and then fail to provide four witnesses, give them eighty lashes

2 those who are present

(2:133) أَمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبَ الْمَوْتُ were you there to bear witness when death came upon Jacob?

3 witnesses/martyrs

(3:140) وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنْكُمْ شُهَدَاءَ and that God may know those who believe and that He may take martyrs/witnesses from among you

4 pillars of religion, upright ones

(4:135) يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ بِالْقِسْطِ شُهَدَاءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ you who believe, uphold justice and be upright bearing witness for God, even if it is against yourselves.

entries.definitionHtml:
شُهَداء shuhadāʾ [pl. ofشَهيد shahıd]

1 witnesses

(24:4) وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً those who accuse chaste women [of adultery], and then fail to provide four witnesses, give them eighty lashes

2 those who are present

(2:133) أَمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَاءَ إِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوبَ الْمَوْتُ were you there to bear witness when death came upon Jacob?

3 witnesses/martyrs

(3:140) وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنْكُمْ شُهَدَاءَ and that God may know those who believe and that He may take martyrs/witnesses from among you

4 pillars of religion, upright ones

entries.label: أشْهاد
entries.definitionHtml:
أشْهاد ʾashhād [pl. of paucity ofشاهِد shāhid and شَهيد shahıd] few witnesses

(40:51) إِنَّا لَنَنْصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَالَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا فِى الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ الأَشْهَادُ We support Our messengers and those who believe in the present life and on the Day when [the chosen] witnesses arise.

entries.label: أشْهَد
entries.definitionHtml:
أشْهَد ʾashhada [v. IV, doubly trans.]

1 to cause to witness, to cause to see

(18:51) مَا أَشْهَدْتُهُمْ خَلْقَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَلاَ خَلْقَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ I did not make them witness the creation of the heavens and earth, nor the creation of themselves

2 to make someone testify, to cause to bear witness

(7:172) وَأَشْهَدَهُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ أَلَسْتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ and He made them bear witness about themselves, [saying], ‘Am I not your Lord?’

3 to have witness(es)

(2:282) وَأَشْهِدُوا إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ and have witnesses present whenever you trade with one another.

entries.label: اسْتَشْهِد
entries.definitionHtml:
اسْتَشْهِد ʾistashhid [imper. of v. X, trans.] to seek witness(es), to call to witness

(2:282) وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ and call to witness, from among your men, two witnesses.

entries.label: شاهِد
entries.definitionHtml:
شاهِد shāhid I [n., pl. شُهود shuhūd andأشْهاد ʾashhād]

1 witness

(46:10) وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ عَلَى مِثْلِهِ and a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to one like it

2 arbitrator

(12:26) وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا إِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ an arbitrator from her household arbitrated: ‘If his shirt is torn at the front, then it is she who is telling the truth and he is one of the liars’ II [act. part.]

1 one bearing witness, testifying

(9:17) شَاهِدِينَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ بِالْكُفْرِ while bearing witness against themselves to the disbelief [in their souls]

2 one watching, witnessing

(37:150) أَمْ خَلَقْنَا الْمَلاَئِكَةَ إِنَاثًا وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ or did We indeed create the angels as females while they were watching?

3 present, at home

(74:13) وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا and [having] sons by his side.

entries.label: شَهادةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
شَهادةٌ shahādatun I [n., pl. شَهادات shahādāt]

1 testimony

(24:4) وَلاَ تَقْبَلُوا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا and do not accept any testimony of theirs, ever

2 giving testimony, giving evidence

(6:19) قُلْ أَيُّ شَيْءٍ أَكْبَرُ شَهَادَةً قُلِ اللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكُمْ say, ‘What thing is of most weight in giving testimony?’ Say, ‘God is witness between you and me!’

3 evidence

(2:283) وَلاَ تَكْتُمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ and do not conceal the evidence

4 oath

(24:6) فَشَهَادَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ let the oath of each one be four oaths by God that he is telling the truth

5 claim

(43:19) وَجَعَلُوا الْمَلاَئِكَةَ الَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَادُ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَاثًا أَشَهِدُوا خَلْقَهُمْ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمْ وَيُسْأَلُونَ they consider the angels–who are God’s servants–to be female; did they witness their creation?, their claim will be put on record and they will be questioned [about it]

6 (as opposed to غَيْب ghayb (q.v.)) the observable, or perceived, by the senses, in particular the sight *

(59:22) عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ [an attribute of God] the One who knows what is hidden and what is seen, the One who knows all, the One whose knowledge encompasses all that can or cannot be perceived by beings other than Himself

7 the testimony that ‘there is no deity but God and Muḥammad is His messenger’ (according to ʾibn ʿabbās’ interpretation of verse 70:33) وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِمْ قَائِمُونَ and those who stand by their testimony [that ‘there is no deity but God and Muḥammad is His messenger’] II [v. n.] testifying

(5:106) يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا شَهَادَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ حِينَ الْوَصِيَّةِ اثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ you who believe, [the method of] testifying among you when death approaches any of you and you are making a bequest, is to let two just men act as witnesses.

entries.label: شَهيد
entries.definitionHtml:
شَهيد shahıd [n. dualشَهيديَن shahıdayn/quasi‐act. part.]

1 witness

(2:282) وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ and call to witness, from among your men, two witnesses

2 attentive

(50:37) أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ or listened in with full attention

3 present

(4:72) فَإِنْ أَصَابَتْكُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ قَالَ قَدْ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيَّ إِذْ لَمْ أَكُنْ مَعَهُمْ شَهِيدًا if a calamity befalls you, he says, ‘God has been gracious to me that I was not there with them’

4 watcher over, overseer, caretaker

(5:117) وَكُنْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ I was a watcher over them as long as I was among them

5 judge, arbitrator

(10:29) فَكَفَى بِاللَّهِ شَهِيدًا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ God is judge enough between us and you.

entries.label: شَهِدَ
entries.definitionHtml:
شَهِدَ shahida a [v. trans.]

1 to observe, to witness, to be present at

(24:2) وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَائِفَةٌ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ and let a group of believers witness their punishment; *

(2:185) فَمَنْ شَهِدَ مِنْكُمُ الشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ [jur.] to qualify for the fast, to possess all the conditions which make fasting obligatory for individuals [lit. any one of you who is ‘present’ during the month [of Ramaḍān] should fast]

2 to attend to, to take care of

(22:28) لِيَشْهَدُوا مَنَافِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ فِى أَيَّامٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ to attend to business of theirs and to pronounce God’s name on specified days

3 to testify to

(12:81) يَاأَبَانَا إِنَّ ابْنَكَ سَرَقَ وَمَا شَهِدْنَا إِلاَّ بِمَا عَلِمْنَا our father, your son stole, and we only testify to what we know

4 to declare

(63:1) ِأذَا جَاءَكَ الْمُنَافِقُونَ قَالُوا نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ when the hypocrites come to you [Prophet], they say, ‘We declare that you are the Messenger of God’

5 (applied to God) to know, to say

(3:18) شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ God knows (or, says) that there is no god but Him

6 to give judgement, to arbitrate, to give an opinion

(12:26) قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتْنِي عَنْ نَفْسِي وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا إِنْ كَانَ قَمِيصُهُ قُدَّ مِنْ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ he said, ‘She tried to seduce me’, so an arbitrator from her household arbitrated: ‘If his shirt has been torn at the front, then she has spoken truly and he is one of the liars’

7 to give counsel, to advise

(27:32) قَالَتْ يَاأَيُّهَا الْمَلأَُ أَفْتُونِي فِى أَمْرِي مَا كُنْتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّى تَشْهَدُونِ she said, ‘Chieftains, give me your counsel in the matter I am facing: I would never decide on a matter until you advise me’

8 to swear a solemn oath

(24:8) وَيَدْرَأُ عَنْهَا الْعَذَابَ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الْكَاذِبِينَ punishment shall be averted from her if she [in turn] four times swears by God that he is one of the lying

9 to know, to be in the knowledge of (having witnessed)

(3:70) يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ وَأَنْتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ people of the Book, why do you deny God’s revelations when you know they are true?

entries.label: مَشْهود
entries.definitionHtml:
مَشْهود mashhūd [pass. part.]

1 observed, noted, attended, witnessed

(17:78) إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ الْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا recitation at dawn is always witnessed; *

(11:103) يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ an eventful day [lit. a well attended Day]

2 that which is testified for, witnessed

(85:3) وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ by the witness and that which is witnessed.

entries.label: مَشْهَد
entries.definitionHtml:
مَشْهَد mashhad [v. n./n. of place./n. of time] the act of seeing or witnessing; place, or time, of gathering, a scene, an event

(19:37) فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ مَشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ woe to those who disbelieve in the event of an awesome Day.
